definitions.gloss: single-handedly, as a woman on her own
definitions.explanation: Without a husband or any man's help; said admiringly of a mother who raises her children or a woman who runs a business on her own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My mother raised me on her own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{盛|も}り→切り盛り：18640_kirimori⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くした→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}かせた→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: After losing her husband, she put three children through university on her own.

notes:
{女手|おんなで} (a woman's work, a woman's hand) + ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (alone, only). Almost always followed by で and a verb such as ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ or ⟦{切|き}り{盛|も}り→切り盛り：18640_kirimori⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise (children) single-handedly
- {女手|おんなで}{一|ひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}り{盛|も}り→切り盛り：18640_kirimori⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run (a shop, a household) on one's own
